note:
⛔ SNG-466. THE SENSE ROUND AND BONUS-ACTION BUILDUP. Erik: 'I don't know how it will work to concede the momentum that round. I think it would be better to make sure it's TAGGED WITH READ at r1 so it can be used in the SENSE ROUND of a fight then used AGAIN in the action round. We do have a system in place that earns bonus actions in combat, so perhaps we should think through a more elaborate BONUS ACTION BUILDUP SYSTEM.'
⚠️ BUILT ON `charges.json` RATHER THAN BESIDE IT — that file already defines `rate` (every pass banks something) and `gate` (a pass banks its full value or nothing). ⛔ TEMPO IS A CHARGE THAT BANKS IN COMBAT AND SPENDS AS AN ACTION.

theSenseRound.what: ⛔ A ROUND HAS TWO SLOTS: a SENSE slot and an ACTION slot. Most crafts use the action slot. A craft tagged `read` uses the SENSE slot instead — ⚠️ WHICH MEANS IT DOES NOT COST YOU YOUR ACTION, and the same craft can be used again in the action slot the same round.
theSenseRound.why: ⚠️ My first draft had the reader FORFEIT the round's momentum. ⛔ ERIK IS RIGHT THAT THIS IS BOTH HARD TO WIRE AND WRONG IN FEEL: a fighter who reads their opponent is not standing still, they are fighting and watching. The sense slot says that plainly.
theSenseRound.rule: ⛔ A CRAFT MAY OCCUPY THE SENSE SLOT ONLY IF IT CARRIES THE `read` TAG. One sense action per round.

readTag.grants: resolves in the sense slot; does not consume the action slot
readTag.note: ⚠️ The `read` tag is NOT the same as the `reveal` FUNCTION. Reveal says what the craft produces; read says WHEN IT RESOLVES.

tempo.what: ⛔ TEMPO IS A BANKED CHARGE. It accrues during a contest and spends as an extra action slot.

accrual.note: ⚠️ Per `charges.json`: every qualifying pass banks something. There is no zero pass.

spend.2 tempo: an action that would normally take the whole round — a full crafting, a long shot, a considered strike
spend.3 tempo: ⛔ ACT BEFORE THE ROUND OPENS, ahead of everyone, once

tempo.cap: ⚠️ THREE. Tempo does not bank across a contest — it is momentum, not savings, and it empties when the fight ends.
tempo._whyItIsGood: ⛔ IT REWARDS THE THING THE TRADITIONS ACTUALLY DO. A Cogitant reads and banks; a Marcher wins rounds and banks; a Figurist prepares ground and banks; a careful fighter conserving energy banks slowly. ⚠️ AND SURGE BANKS NOTHING — the gamble is already its own reward, so the greedy line and the patient line are genuinely different strategies rather than one being strictly better.

wiring: add a `senseSlot` to the round alongside the action slot
a craft with `read: true` resolves in the sense slot and does not consume the action
tempo accrues per the rate table above and caps at 3
tempo spends per the spend table; spending is declared before the round's rolls
forCCode.smallest: ⛔ THE MINIMUM VIABLE VERSION IS THE `read` TAG AND THE SENSE SLOT. Tempo can follow; the sense slot alone makes Deduced Strike work as authored.
